name: Rayvn polling
info: Polls the Rayvn API at regular intervals to fetch log entries. Checks configuration, builds authorized request, and returns log entries for processing.

name: Build Rayvn Entry Request
info: Builds an HTTP request to fetch log entries from Rayvn. Sets Authorization header with Bearer token from rayvnConfig.apiKey and builds URL to /logs/{logId}/entries endpoint.

name: Get Rayvn Entries
info: Fetches all log entries from Rayvn API with GET request. Returns an array of entries that are processed further in the flow.

name: Verify config
info: Validates that required global variables are configured (rayvnConfig, rayvnLogId). Stops the flow if something is missing. This ensures we don't try to communicate with the API without valid configuration.

name: Rayvn Poll
info: Sends inject at regular intervals while the application is running.
